review_notes: I read the whole file. Each lemma is a short, separate step: closed-set and open-set facts, convexity, the interior, the closure, the frontier, and the final Jordan-interior theorem. No nontrivial reasoning appears in two proofs. The closed and open closedness/openness proofs have a similar shape, but each is a two-line application of an existing Mathlib lemma. A shared helper would not be worth the extra declaration. I also grepped the SLE directory for similar interior, closure and frontier arguments, and for other uses of complexInside_eq_open. The only other caller is DiskBoundaryRegion, which handles the full disk and shares no nontrivial machinery. I found nothing else repeated, so I report no finding for this rubric.
